spec=h.read_json(old/'spec.json');regions=h.read_json(old/'regions.json');fid='whiterun-outdoor-fixed-float-precision-20260916'
spec['sceneFingerprint']=regions['sceneFingerprint']=fid
camera={k:acq['cameraEvidence'][k] for k in ['view','projection','positionAdjust']};camera.update(viewTolerance=0.000001,projectionTolerance=0.000001,positionAdjustTolerance=0.015625)
spec['fixedScene']['cameraEvidence']=camera

plan=h.make_plan(spec,regions,19417);c.validate_plan(plan);c.validate_fixed_scene(plan['fixedScene'])
for name,value in [('spec',spec),('regions',regions),('private-plan',plan)]:h.save_json(root/(name+'.json'),value)
i=h.read_json(old/'campaign-index.json');i.update(planPath=str(root/'private-plan.json'),planSha256=h.digest(root/'private-plan.json'),sceneFingerprint=fid,sequences=[],parentAttempt=str(old),retryReason='Frozen pose position tolerance below float32 precision; new predeclared plan retains all prior rejected evidence and the same image threshold/regions.')
h.save_json(root/'campaign-index.json',i)
data={'plan':plan,'schedule':plan['schedule'],'candidateConfigurations':h.read_json(root/'candidate-configurations.json')};h.save_json(root/'plan-data.json',data)
print(json.dumps({'steps':len(plan['schedule']),'positionTolerance':camera['positionAdjustTolerance'],'planSha256':i['planSha256']}))
